headline: Public hearings on a Flex Storage Building at 154 East Main Street and a manufacturing building on Clark Avenue.
summary: The agenda includes public hearings on wetlands and floodplain applications for two projects. New applications cover sites on East Main Street, Camp Street, and Riverside Avenue.
items: New application 2080: wetlands application for a commercial building with parking at 225 East Main Street (Assessor's Map 41, Map 19), applicants Rafal Zagrobelny and Marzena Gap
New application #26-467F-320: floodplain application for a commercial building with parking at 225 East Main Street (Assessor's Map 41, Map 19), applicants Rafal Zagrobelny and Marzena Gap
New application 2081: wetlands boundary change at 59 Camp Street (Map 42, Lot 68), applicant Carrier Holdings, LLC

New application #2066: modification to the building footprint and infrastructure for a 2-story, 8,559 sq. ft. data center at 234 Riverside Avenue (Assessor's Map 30, Lot 117A), applicant ReNew Riverside, LLC
New application #2082: wetlands application for a 7,861 sq. ft. gravel pad at 220 Riverside Avenue for a carbon capture system (Assessor's Map 30, Lot 117), applicant ReNew Riverside, LLC

Public hearing on application 2074: wetlands boundary change for a 12,250 sq. ft. Flex Storage Building at Map 41, Lots 33A & 34, and 154 East Main Street (Assessor's Map 41, Lots 33A, 34, & 34E), applicants Thirty-Three Thirty-Four Associates, LLC and Brianna Senese
Public hearing on application 2075: wetlands application for the 12,250 sq. ft. Flex Storage Building at the same site, applicants Thirty-Three Thirty-Four Associates, LLC and Brianna Senese
Public hearing on application #26-467F-318: floodplain application for the 12,250 sq. ft. Flex Storage Building at Map 41, Lots 33A & 34, applicant Thirty-Three Thirty-Four Associates, LLC

Public hearing on application 2078: wetlands boundary change for a 68,400 sq. ft. manufacturing building at Clark Avenue (Assessor's Map 66, Lot 261A-1+261A-2), applicant Borghesi Building and Engineering, owner Stephen O. Allaire - Esquire

Public hearing on application 2079: wetlands application for the 68,400 sq. ft. manufacturing building at Clark Avenue (Assessor's Map 66, Lot 261A-1+261A-2), applicant Borghesi Building and Engineering, owner Stephen O. Allaire - Esquire
